producer_report.summary:
Root cause: a plan demonstration carried no field for the test seam, so the planning flow never required naming it. Athena's plan check, `admission::plan_findings`, had no seam rule to apply, and the critic had no seam in front of it. Jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs and 20261024-115052-bzw6 stopped at planning round 3 for this reason. The prompts already asked for a seam in prose, but nothing enforced it.

What changed:
- **Schema and record:** `DemonstrationOutput` and the stored `Demonstration` gain `seam: Option<String>`, with a doc comment naming the entry point, the fake or fixture and its injection, and `exists` or the step that adds it. The stored field has a serde default and is skipped when none, so old plan records still parse and re-serialize byte for byte.
- **Gate:** `plan_findings` gives a Major finding for a behavior criterion whose seam is missing or blank. It names the criterion and sends the plan back to the planner with no critic call. `plan_record` copies the field.
- **Briefs:** `demonstration_lines` prints `Test seam:` under each demonstration, so the critic, producer and verifier all see it. The critic still checks that the seam exists in the code.
- **Fixtures:** the fake planner and the athena-cli plan fixtures now give a seam. The test harness capability may now run `cargo test`.
- **Tests added:**
  - Two admission unit tests cover missing, empty and blank seams, a named seam, and a content criterion.
  - Two end-to-end tests run the planning loop: a seamless plan is revised with no critic call, and a plan that never names a seam stops after 2 mechanical revisions.
  - A brief rendering test and a record round-trip test were also added.
  - With the new rule disabled, 3 of the 4 core seam tests failed (the accepted-cases test still passed). I then restored the rule.
- **Changelog:** CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased.

fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed, and so did the banned-word scan (`cargo test -p xtask --test policy`).

The expected files run/mod.rs and status.rs needed no edit."

checks_run.note: Includes the new brief rendering test and the new record round-trip and check_record_file test.
4 tests: two in admission.rs, two end to end in run/tests.rs.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-core --lib seam, with the new rule in admission.rs temporarily disabled
checks_run.note: Expected: 3 of the 4 tests failed (the fourth is the accepted-cases test). The rule was then restored and the tests passed.
Run once. The tool output was too large to display, but it reported no failure and no error exit code. I could not read the saved output, so I did not check the per-crate counts.
12 tests passed, including the banned-word scan.

criteria_check.criterion: The change description names the root cause: plan demonstrations carry no field for the test seam, so the planning flow never requires naming or confirming the seam. Cites jobs 20261018-095726-r3bn, 20261018-113512-gvcs and 20261024-115052-bzw6.
criteria_check.evidence: The CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry says a plan demonstration carried no field for the test seam, so the planning flow never required naming it and Athena's plan check had nothing to test. It cites all three job ids. The summary repeats this.

criteria_check.criterion: DemonstrationOutput in crates/athena-context/src/outputs.rs and Demonstration in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs gain a `seam` field, with a doc comment naming entry point, fake injection and exists-or-added-by-step. The records field has a serde default so old records parse.
criteria_check.evidence: Both structs have `seam: Option<String>` with a doc comment naming the production entry point, the fake or fixture and how it is injected, and exists or the step that adds it. The records field has `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`. The athena-data test `a_demonstration_seam_is_optional_in_old_records_and_round_trips_when_set` passed.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs renders the seam beside each demonstration, so the critic sees it (check with Grep for the seam label near the Demonstrations: heading).
criteria_check.evidence: `demonstration_lines` in briefs.rs prints `  Test seam: <seam>` after the fails_without line, and the `Demonstrations:` heading calls it. The test `a_demonstrations_test_seam_is_rendered_beneath_it_and_only_when_set` passed, and `critic_briefs_carry_the_demonstrations...` now asserts the label. The end-to-end test also saw the label in the critic's real prompt.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a new test shows planning refuses a plan whose behavior-criterion demonstration has an empty or missing seam, with an error naming the criterion, and accepts the same plan with a seam. The test fails on the code before the change.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core --lib seam` passed 4 tests. The unit test covers None, empty and blank seams: each gives one Major finding at `demonstrations, criterion 1` naming the criterion and the seam. It also checks that a seam is accepted and that a content criterion needs none. The end-to-end tests run the planning loop. A seamless plan is revised with no critic call, and a seam is then accepted and shown to the critic. A seamless plan that never names a seam stops with `behavior criterion 1 ... after 2 mechanical revisions`. With the rule disabled, 3 of the 4 failed (the accepted-cases test still passed).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data` and `cargo test -p athena-cli`: a plan record without `seam` still passes check_record_file and round-trips as AnyRecord, and a record with the seam round-trips unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: The athena-data test checks that a record with no seam has no `seam` key, passes check_record_file, parses as AnyRecord and re-serializes byte for byte. A record with a seam round-trips equal and passes check_record_file. athena-cli ran inside the one full `cargo test --locked` run, which reported no failure; the saved output was too large for me to read, so I did not check the cli counts.

criteria_check.criterion: The change refuses more plans, and the higher refusal rate is intended: expected 10% of newly refused plans, namely behavior criteria with no named seam.
criteria_check.evidence: The refusal is limited to behavior criteria with a missing or blank seam. The unit test shows a content criterion with no seam and a behavior criterion with a seam are both accepted. The 10% share is an estimate from the brief; I did not measure it.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` from the repository root; all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I also ran fmt --check, clippy --locked -D warnings and the full test suite once; all passed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new required seam field and the planning refusal.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first bullet under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Added` covers the seam field, the Major finding without a critic call, the `Test seam:` rendering, and that old records still load.

open_issues: The seam is free text. A hollow seam such as `exists` passes Athena's check and only the critic can catch it. This was accepted in the plan and is out of scope.
The 10% refusal share in criterion 6 is the brief's estimate; I did not measure it.

I edited crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs and three athena-cli test files, which are not in the expected deliverables. The rule has to live in admission.rs, and the fixtures and the fake planner need a seam, as the accepted plan said.
mistakes: My first end-to-end test failed because the harness verifier could run no command. I fixed it by granting `cargo test` in the Docs capability, not by loosening the new rule.
I could not read the saved output of the full test run, so I did not check per-crate counts.
learnings: Root cause: the planner prompt, the critic frame and the planner brief already ask for a named seam in prose, and a briefs.rs test pins that wording (`planning_prompts_and_brief_require_a_named_test_seam`). Nothing enforced it. DemonstrationOutput had no seam field and `admission::plan_findings` had no seam rule, so a plan that ignored the prose passed Athena's checks. A Major finding there reuses the two mechanical passes, which cost no critic call.

The test harness capability in run/tests.rs (`Docs`) gave the verifier no command, so any behavior demonstration would get a 'command the verifier may not run' finding. I granted it `cargo test`. No test depended on the old empty list.
The fake planner in athena-agent gave every criterion a fails_without, so it needed a seam to keep passing the new rule.
`cargo fmt --all` reflows the new test code, so run it before the final check.
A missing `Option` key parses as None without a serde default, so the planner's output schema keeps the key required while old JSON fixtures that omit `seam` still parse.
desires: A way to read a persisted large test output, for example a command that shows only summary lines, so I could check per-crate counts.
A fixture in run/tests.rs whose capability can run a command, so a behavior criterion needs no edit to the shared Docs capability.
